Stephen R. Graubard (ed.), The Artificial Intelligence Debate. False Starts, Real Foundations. Cambridge Mass., Londen: The MIT Press, 1988.
This volume, previously published as a 'Special Issue' of the journal Daedalus, contains fourteen papers on Artificial Intelli- gence. Its authors come from such diverse disciplines as com- puter science, mathematics, biology, sociology and philosophy.
